text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid...! May,
she did it! <chrname> has—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheering loud enough to split the sky
rang 
out, celebrating the incredible feat 
achieved by <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I escorted her as she was completely 
exhausted, and together we headed toward 
the podium.

text_block_list.name: Reporter from Japan
text_block_list.text:
...Huh...? Haha, this is bad... My hands 
are shaking so much, the camera is...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Look. <chrname> is...
A Japanese Umamusume is on 
the podium—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if answering the cheers,
<chrname> raises the 
trophy high towards the sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, across the distant sea— I felt 
like I could hear the cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe had come
to 
an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the stars on the way back
to 
the hotel.
The afterglow of victory showed 
no signs of fading.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...<chrname> has become a champion.
Which title 
shall we dedicate to her next?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is this really okay, Sirius-senpai~? 
Sneaking out of the hotel like this~?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Right back at you, El. And here I 
thought you were on the good kids' side."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El isn't the only one struggling to 
contain all this heat.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
My, my, what a large gathering we have 
here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "...Nakayama. You take care of this one."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Damn it, don't just start running 
already!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Cafe-san...? Are you all right...?
You 
look pale..."
